newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi sees Italy inflation levelling out.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi sees Italy inflation levelling out.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Tuesday he saw inflation levelling out at around November's 2.6 percent.

"I would be satisfied if in December, inflation was more or less at November's levels, 0.1 point higher or lower," he told a news conference on the activities of the European Investment Bank in Italy.
"We can't expect inflation to fall at the rate we have seen in the last seven months," Ciampi said.
He added that he saw a "levelling out at November levels in the coming months".
Provisional December consumer price inflation data from 10 sample Italian cities will be published on Thursday and Friday. Final December CPI data is due out on January 8.
